speaker: alse_pinder
text: He is on Master Field's book, sir. I am putting him on the Chaucer. I am not making a speech, and I am not touching the sheet on your board.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Put him there. Leave the sheet. It is not going out tonight.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I came up both turnings, and I am not coming up a third for a cat. I cannot read your letter, so I am in no danger of carrying it by mistake.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Both turnings is the whole of the errand. Good night.
